title: Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury
content: Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury is a platform video game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch. It is a port of the Wii U game Super Mario 3D World, released worldwide in February 2021. The game includes the original Super Mario 3D World and a new standalone adventure called Bowser's Fury.
